currentState: Chapter 4: real warmth, in words as well as hands. Lyriel is the escort who touches Jaina's hands and talks to her as a person: first-name 'Jaina' (arrives mid-sentence in the knot lesson), joking, tying her knot, rebinding her torn palm in the night. Jaina trusts her with the staff, accepts help mounting, and asks to be re-taught ('Again.'). Jaina calls her 'Lyriel' aloud, no title. Still guarded on both sides about Jaina's status as prisoner; nothing disloyal shown.
currentState_chapter3: The first thaw continues in action, not words: Lyriel grips the mage's mare when it spooks, moves up beside her while she sleeps, holds the stirrup for her to mount. No dialogue between them on page in chapter 3.
powerDynamic: Lyriel is an escort with orders (right flank, close to Jaina's reins) and a courteous manner; Jaina is the charge.
currentState_chapter7: Chapter 7 (Sylvanas's POV): Lyriel is Jaina's body and eyes in the one place Sylvanas cannot go. She lifts Jaina down in the carter's yard, stands half a step behind at the gate, slides the pass into Jaina's coat when she might fumble it, goes with her through the inspection offices with a hand under her elbow, stops when Jaina stops, and is half a step off the shutter when Jaina rises in case she falls. Sylvanas's thought: 'Lyriel would watch the corridors and catch Jaina when she went over.' No spoken exchange between them on the page; the care is physical and unasked.
currentState_chapter6: Chapter 6 (Jaina's POV): Lyriel is the body's keeper. She lifts Jaina down and up at every stop, hands over half an apple (and half for the mare), turns round at Jaina's plain statement, says 'Jaina. Your nose.', offers the wall and a rest ('She'd be glad of a rest even if you wouldn't'), and when Jaina refuses puts her hand over Jaina's to steady the mare and lets go. She does not press or argue. No jokes this chapter. No link to the tally-man.
currentState_chapter5: Chapter 5 (seen from Sylvanas's POV): warm and practical. Lyriel takes Jaina's weight at every stirrup, rides at her knee, fist in the back of her coat after the mare goes down; jokes ('paid by the loop, Jaina') and makes her laugh aloud for the first time on the road; saves her the burnt crust ('it's the best bit') and Jaina eats it with two fingers. Lyriel says 'Jaina' aloud; no 'Lady Proudmoore'.

physicalDynamics.pattern: Chapter 4: Lyriel takes the cheek-strap at the spook in the lane ('Steady,' to the horse or to her); lifts Jaina at the waist off the saddle and lets go; holds the staff's crystal against patients under Jaina's cheek ('If it bites me, Lady Proudmoore, I'm letting go.'); crosses a bed to put her hands over Jaina's on a bandage; keeps a hand at the small of Jaina's back in the dark granary and the stair; 'Jaina, leave it.'; sits on the flags in the night and takes Jaina's left hand without asking, cuts the linen, washes it, rebinds it with the same knot and bites it down; shakes out a spare cloak over Tam; cupped-hand step at dawn; grins at Jaina's knot from the brazier.
Rides at Jaina's right knee close enough to reach her reins; takes her reins below the mare's chin when she panics, then lets go; Jaina nods thanks.
Keeps her face carefully on the road while Jaina dozes.
Stands above the ditch with bow in hand while Jaina reads the doe.

Chapter 3: leans across at the spook, takes the mare by the cheekpiece and brings her round without a word; stands the gallery above the mage's well read; moves up to the sleeping mage's knee 'without being told' and hooks two fingers through the cheek-strap; holds the far stirrup when the mage mounts after a long struggle.

nameUsage.lyrielCallsJaina: 'Lady Proudmoore' (Ch2; twice early in Ch4: dry, teasing) -> 'Jaina' (Ch4, first mid-sentence in the knot lesson: 'Go on, Jaina. Bite it.'; again 'Jaina, leave it.'). Jaina notices the first one instantly.
nameUsage.jainaCallsLyriel: Ch3: no name aloud. Ch4: 'Lyriel' aloud, bare, many times.

history.event: Jaina laughs at Lyriel's remark about the Ranger-Lord ('Then I'll try to go on taking it better than a Ranger-Lord'); Lyriel exchanges a glance with Cyndia, who ignores it.
Lyriel shoots the wolf that went for Jaina's mare; boasts she has crossed the Pass with less ice under her; Jaina has nothing to say back.
Chapter 3: Lyriel steadies the mage's mare, keeps pace with her sleeping, and holds her stirrup.

history_chapter4.event: Lyriel teaches Jaina the one-handed Farstrider bandage knot (loop over thumb, wrist under, tail through, set with the teeth; 'We learn it so we can patch our own mistakes.'). Jaina asks 'Again.' and ties the next dressing herself; Lyriel snorts at her gunners' oath.

Jaina overrules Lyriel's 'leave it' in the loft ('I'm reading it') and pays with the left palm; Lyriel then cuts the hand free of its linen in the night and rebinds it ('Don't let Tobin see that. He'll want to bleed you as well.'); 'Not on your own hand, you can't. Not yet. Tomorrow.'
In Brask's ledger Lyriel asks him to write that one of them ties a good knot, glancing at Cyndia; Jaina ties Garran's bandage unaided at dawn and Lyriel grins.

history_chapter6.event: Lyriel lifts Jaina under the arms down in Strahnbrad mud and back up afterwards, 'as she had at every stop since the sick village'.

On the walled lane Jaina's nose bleeds; Lyriel says 'Jaina. Your nose.' and 'Get down a moment. Sit on the wall. I'll hold her for you.' Jaina: 'No.' Lyriel moves in until their knees touch, steadies Jaina's hand and the mare, and lets go when the mare calms. Jaina rides on.

history_chapter7.event: Chapter 7: Lyriel lifts Jaina off the mare in the straw of the carter's yard, takes the pass from her fingers and tucks it into her coat at the gate, and goes with her and Corin to the sample room; she brings Jaina home on her arm, stopping each time Jaina stops.

Chapter 7: Lyriel moves in from the door to put a hand under Jaina's elbow before anyone asks when the sample room is named; at the shutter she stays half a step off in case Jaina falls when she rises.

trajectory_chapter7: Chapter 7: the care is silent and practical; Lyriel's job is now partly set by Sylvanas ('catch Jaina when she went over').
trajectory_chapter6: Chapter 6: the care is physical and uncomplaining; Lyriel offers and is refused, and respects Jaina's agency. Next: the question of when the body forces a stop.
trajectory_chapter5: Chapter 5: Lyriel is the friend, Jaina laughs with her; the relationship is the party's one easy warmth, and it is visible to Sylvanas (and to Cyndia, who does not join).
trajectory: Friendliest hands on the road; still guarded. Chapter 4: becomes the person Jaina learns a skill from; first-name footing established; Lyriel is the escort most open to Jaina.
